sourceQuestions.sourceText: Join the two sentences with and. Tiger is hungry. Tiger is cross. → Tiger is hungry ___
Does the sentence have a verb? Tick the correct ones and cross the wrong ones. a Tiddalik drank the water. b The water everywhere. c Kangaroo boxed his shadow. d Wombat about the water.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a ✓ • b ✗ (no verb) • c ✓ • d ✗ (no verb)

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Draw a line from each animal to what it did. Tiddalik Kookaburra Kangaroo Platypus / told jokes, boxed his shadow, got cross and looked silly, drank all the water
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Tiddalik – drank all the water • Kookaburra – told jokes • Kangaroo – boxed his shadow • Platypus – got cross and looked silly

sourceQuestions.sourceText: How did the man feel when Tiger grabbed him?
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Scared / frightened ("surprised" or "sad" show good thinking too)

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Who tricked Tiger back into the trap?
Finish the sentence with a story opener. ___, there was a thirsty frog.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Any opener: Once upon a time, Long ago, Long, long ago, One day

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write the verb from each sentence. They all end in ed. a The lion roared. b The water gushed. c The cat pounced.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a roared • b gushed • c pounced

sourceQuestions.sourceText: What lesson does Tiddalik the Thirsty Frog teach us?
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: A good answer says we should share and not keep everything for ourselves.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Traditional tales are ( true news reports ) ( very old stories told again and again ) ( lists of instructions )
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: very old stories told again and again

sourceQuestions.sourceText: "Once upon a time" is a ( story opener ) ( verb ) ( rhyme )
Tiddalik laughed when he saw ( a big fish ) ( the sun ) ( Platypus looking silly )
In the lion story, the lion was saved by ( the little mouse ) ( the hunters ) ( the tiger )
Which one is a sentence with a verb? ( The frog in the pond. ) ( A big green frog. ) ( The frog jumped. )
